## NIST’s AI Risk Framework and Its Generative AI Profile

NIST released AI Risk Management Framework 1.0 in January 2023 as a voluntary, broad framework to help organizations incorporate trustworthiness considerations across AI design, development, use, and evaluation.

In July 2024, NIST published AI 600-1, a cross-sector companion profile focused on generative AI. The two publications are related but distinct in scope: the framework addresses AI broadly, while the later profile focuses on generative AI. Its status as a companion profile does not mean it replaces the broader framework.
